hypothesis: H5: a morphological curriculum — train a small body first and grow toward the adult — reaches adult competence with far less cumulative damage (and no slower), and balance-first beats walking-from-the-start. v2 scores these as four independent claims: damage_at_competence and steps_parity on the confound-free walk-direct pairing (growth vs adult, both walking from the start), plus gradualism and balance_first.

config.stats: two-sided Mann-Whitney AND Welch t (scipy.stats.ttest_ind equal_var=False), each Holm-adjusted within its family (primary m=4, secondary m=8; robustness m=4 per variant)
config.tuning: hyperparameters tuned once on v1 seeds 0-9; confirmatory seeds are offset to stay disjoint

tau3.note: ROBUSTNESS ARM (reduced seed count, not confirmatory): training physics variant tau_max=40 s^3, damping b=1.0 s^0. adult-walk comparator reused from the main arm restricted to these seeds — variant laws coincide with the default at s=1.0 and rng streams are variant-independent, so a rerun would be bit-identical. Eval unchanged (adult body).

damp2.note: ROBUSTNESS ARM (reduced seed count, not confirmatory): training physics variant tau_max=40 s^2, damping b=1.0 s^2. adult-walk comparator reused from the main arm restricted to these seeds — variant laws coincide with the default at s=1.0 and rng streams are variant-independent, so a rerun would be bit-identical. Eval unchanged (adult body).

claims.claim: Growth curriculum (walk-direct) reaches adult competence with far less cumulative damage than adult training (grow-linear-walk and grow-adaptive-walk vs adult-walk; confound-free morphology contrast, task staging matched).
claims.evidence: Damage IQM: grow-linear-walk 100.4 vs adult-walk 928.5 (MW Holm p=5.7e-14, Welch Holm p=3.8e-35); grow-adaptive-walk 22.0 vs 928.5 (MW Holm p=5.7e-14, Welch Holm p=4.3e-30). Censoring sensitivity (drop / worst-case MW p): grow-linear-walk 3.4e-14 / 4.7e-12; grow-adaptive-walk 9.7e-14 / 5.7e-09. Standing-only guard: lean-target on-target IQM at competence grow-linear-walk 0.05, grow-adaptive-walk 0.20, adult-walk 0.01 (nonzero = tracking, not standing). Balance-first-staged growth arms agree (secondary family): grow-linear vs adult-walk damage MW Holm p=3.1e-11, grow-adaptive p=1.1e-13.

claims.claim: Growth curriculum (walk-direct) reaches adult competence no slower than adult training, within a pre-registered +20% equivalence margin (never scored by accepting a null).
claims.evidence: Steps to competence (censored=budget+1): grow-linear-walk 49000 vs adult-walk 81000 (diff IQM -32000 steps, 95% CI [-40600, -23800], margin +16200 (20% of adult IQM); MW Holm p=1.7e-10, Welch Holm p=3.9e-12) -> supported; grow-adaptive-walk 52000 vs 81000 (diff IQM -29000 steps, 95% CI [-39800, -15400], margin +16200 (20% of adult IQM); MW Holm p=2.4e-05, Welch Holm p=3.1e-05) -> supported. Balance-first-staged growth arms (secondary, context): grow-linear 95800 vs adult-walk 81000 (MW Holm p=0.01, Welch Holm p=0.011).

claims.claim: Gradual growth beats abrupt growth on damage (grow-linear < grow-jump, matched balance-first staging).
claims.evidence: Damage IQM: grow-linear 446.8 vs grow-jump 156.2; point estimate in the OPPOSITE direction — abrupt growth was cheaper; MW Holm p=2.1e-06, Welch Holm p=5.1e-07 (secondary family, m=8).

claims.claim: Balance-first task staging beats walking-from-the-start within matched morphology (adult-balance-first < adult-walk and grow-linear < grow-linear-walk on steps).
claims.evidence: Steps IQM: adult-balance-first 101600 vs adult-walk 81000 (MW Holm p=0.00094, Welch Holm p=0.00074) -> refuted; grow-linear 95800 vs grow-linear-walk 49000 (MW Holm p=6.5e-11, Welch Holm p=3.1e-15) -> refuted. REVERSED: walking-from-the-start was FASTER on both matched-morphology comparisons.

conclusion.summary: EXP5 v2 per-claim verdicts (primary = walk-direct pairing, morphology isolated): damage_at_competence: SUPPORTED | steps_parity: SUPPORTED | gradualism: REFUTED (reversed: abrupt growth was cheaper) | balance_first: REFUTED (reversed: walk-from-the-start was faster). Censored fractions: adult-walk 0.05, adult-balance-first 0.17, grow-linear 0.17, grow-adaptive 0.12, grow-jump 0.07, grow-linear-walk 0.00, grow-adaptive-walk 0.07. Physics robustness (tau3: growth arms all cheaper than adult-walk = True; damp2: growth arms all cheaper than adult-walk = True). Both Mann-Whitney and Welch reported, Holm within family; steps parity scored by equivalence CI against a +20% margin, never by accepting a null.

conditions.adult-walk: s=1.0 throughout, walking task from the start
conditions.adult-balance-first: s=1.0; target fixed at 0 for first 30%, then walking
conditions.grow-linear: s 0.5->1.0 over first 60% of budget; balance-first
conditions.grow-adaptive: grow s by 0.05 when rolling no-fall rate > 70%; balance-first
conditions.grow-jump: s=0.5 for 60% of budget then s=1.0; balance-first
conditions.grow-linear-walk: grow-linear schedule but walking task from the start
conditions.grow-adaptive-walk: grow-adaptive gate but walking task from the start

meta.reward: +1/step upright, +2/step within 0.05 rad of target, -5 on a fall (fixed across sizes; physical damage recorded separately)
meta.damping: default b = 1.0 constant across sizes -> relative damping b/(m l^2) = 1/(15 s^5), ~32x stronger for s=0.5 than adult (v1 deviation, disclosed); damp2 variant scales b = 1.0 s^2
meta.eval: adult body s=1.0, greedy, walking targets
